look: Geode Cube, a B-rank GKOM variant from the Gloam Oozes family: corridor-filling translucent cube with bones and crystal suspended inside. Family anatomy: translucent jellies and gel cubes with half-dissolved crystal shards drifting inside. Build: large, heavy and imposing. GKOM rank cue: half the body armoured in GKOM crystal, natural patches between the plates; the crystals are murky violet gel crystal. A softball-sized GKOM core orb, dark crimson with a steady pulse, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Water: aqua, deep blue and pearl accents, strong ribbons of water, bubbles and moonlit spray
